source.original_text:
Suppose signed cell masses along a cofinal sequence of dyadic levels have uniformly bounded total absolute mass. If their prefix sums at each fixed dyadic node converge to the prefix integral of an integrable time density, the left-endpoint sum against any continuous weight converges to the integral of the weighted density.

The horizon T is positive and the sequence of fine levels tends to infinity.
The real weight w is continuous on [0,T], and the real density b is integrable against the horizon time measure.
The total absolute cell mass is uniformly bounded along the specified sequence. For every fixed dyadic node, the inclusive fine prefix converges to the integral primitive of b at that node.

\sum_i w(t_{\sigma(n),i})z_{\sigma(n),i}\longrightarrow\int_{[0,T]}w(s)b(s)\,ds.

theorem anonymous_target
  {T : NNReal} (hT : 0 < T) (w b : NNReal → ℝ) (hw : ContinuousOn w (Set.Icc 0 T))
  (hb : MeasureTheory.Integrable b (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T))
  (z : (n : ℕ) → Fin (2 ^ n) → ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (hσ : Filter.Tendsto σ Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hVar : ∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i, |z (σ n) i| ≤ M) :
  have t := fun n =>
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.regularGridTimes
      (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.SampledElementaryApproximation.dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n);
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, if t (σ n) i.succ ≤ t m k then z (σ n) i else 0) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.PrefixIntegral.prefixIntegral b T (t m k)))) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i, w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) * z (σ n) i) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ (s : NNReal), w s * b s ∂AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T))

blind_reconstruction.text:
Objects: Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. For n in N put t[n,i]=i*T/2^n for i=0,...,2^n, and Delta_i^n Z=Z(t[n,i+1])-Z(t[n,i]). Define P_b(t)=integral 1_{s<min(t,T)}*b(s)d lambda_T(s).

Domains: T>0 in R_+; w,b:R_+->R; z_n:{0,...,2^n-1}->R for every n in N; sigma:N->N.

Quantifiers: Universally T,hT,w,b,hw,hb,z,sigma,hSigma,hVar. hVar has order exists real M, forall n, sum_i |z_{sigma(n),i}|<=M. Then assume for every m and k in {0,...,2^m}, convergence of the prefix sums along n; conclude convergence of the weighted sums along n.

Assumptions: w is continuous on [0,T], b is lambda_T-integrable, sigma(n)->infinity (no monotonicity or injectivity required), and the total absolute sums sum_i |z_{sigma(n),i}| have one common finite real upper bound M. For every fixed m,k, sum_i 1_{t[sigma(n),i+1]<=t[m,k]}*z_{sigma(n),i} tends to P_b(t[m,k]).

Conclusion: As n->infinity, sum_i w(t[sigma(n),i])*z_{sigma(n),i} tends in R to integral_0^T w(s)*b(s)ds.

Scopes: Deterministic scalar convergence, with hypotheses at each fixed dyadic prefix endpoint. It does not assert uniform convergence of all prefixes. The prefix definition uses s<min(t,T), whereas the discrete cutoff uses right endpoint<=t[m,k]. All weight evaluations are at left endpoints. Bounds and convergence are only along sigma.

Constant dependencies: M is existential after z,sigma and may depend on all prior data; it is independent of n. No rate constant is concluded.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicBlockWeights
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ItoWeightedRiemannSums

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicWeightedLimits

open Filter MeasureTheory Set
open scoped BigOperators NNReal Topology
open ElementaryItoIntegral SampledElementaryApproximation FiniteTimeGrid
  DyadicElementaryRefinement DyadicBlockWeights ItoWeightedRiemannSums
open AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.PrefixIntegral

/-- Cumulative limits on dyadic cutoffs and bounded total absolute mass
imply convergence against every continuous left-endpoint weight. -/
theorem tendsto_dyadic_weighted_sums_of_prefix_limits
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (w b : ℝ≥0 → ℝ)
    (hw : ContinuousOn w (Icc 0 T)) (hb : Integrable b (TimeMeasure.upTo T))
    (z : (n : ℕ) → Fin (2 ^ n) → ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (hσ : Tendsto σ atTop atTop)
    (hVar : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n, ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), |z (σ n) i| ≤ M) :
    let t := fun n => regularGridTimes (dyadicMesh T n) (2 ^ n)
    (∀ m (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)), Tendsto (fun n =>
      ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), if t (σ n) i.succ ≤ t m k then z (σ n) i else 0)
      atTop (𝓝 (prefixIntegral b T (t m k)))) →
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) * z (σ n) i)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ s, w s * b s ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T))) := by
  intro t hPrefix
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hVar
  let C := max M 1
  have hC : 0 < C := zero_lt_one.trans_le (le_max_right _ _)
  let P (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) (n : ℕ) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), if t (σ n) i.succ ≤ t m k then z (σ n) i else 0
  let L (m : ℕ) := ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m), w (t m j.castSucc) *
    (prefixIntegral b T (t m j.succ) - prefixIntegral b T (t m j.castSucc))
  let V (m n : ℕ) := ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m), w (t m j.castSucc) *
    (P m j.succ n - P m j.castSucc n)
  let S (n : ℕ) := ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) * z (σ n) i
  let I := ∫ s, w s * b s ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hV (m : ℕ) : Tendsto (V m) atTop (𝓝 (L m)) := by
    refine tendsto_finsetSum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact ((hPrefix m j.succ).sub (hPrefix m j.castSucc)).const_mul _
  have hL : Tendsto L atTop (𝓝 I) :=
    tendsto_dyadic_weighted_prefixIntegral_sums w b T hT hw hb
  have ht (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) : t m i ≤ T :=
    ((regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT m) _).monotone (Fin.le_last i)).trans_eq
      (regularDyadic_last_time T m)
  change Tendsto S atTop (𝓝 I)
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  let δ := ε / (3 * C)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hε (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hwmod⟩ :=
    (Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1 (isCompact_Icc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hw)) δ hδ
  have hChoice : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      (dyadicMesh T m : ℝ) < r ∧ dist (L m) I < ε / 3 :=
    (eventually_dyadicMesh_lt T hr).and ((Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 hL) _ (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨m, hmMesh, hmL⟩ := hChoice.exists
  filter_upwards [hσ.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop m),
    (Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 (hV m)) (ε / 3) (by positivity)] with n hn hmV
  have hBlock : V m n = ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n),
      w (t m (coarseCell hn i).castSucc) * z (σ n) i :=
    (dyadic_sum_coarse_weight_eq_prefix_differences hT hn
      (fun j => w (t m j.castSucc)) (z (σ n))).symm
  have hOsc (i : Fin (2 ^ σ n)) :
      |w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) - w (t m (coarseCell hn i).castSucc)| ≤ δ := by
    let j := coarseCell hn i
    let x := t (σ n) i.castSucc
    let y := t m j.castSucc
    have hyx : y ≤ x := coarse_left_endpoint_le_fine_left (T := T) hn i
    have hfine : t (σ n) i.castSucc ≤ t (σ n) i.succ :=
      (regularGridTimes_strictMono (dyadicMesh_pos hT (σ n)) _).monotone (Fin.castSucc_le_succ i)
    have hxy : x ≤ y + dyadicMesh T m := by
      exact (hfine.trans (fine_right_endpoint_le_coarse_right (T := T) hn i)).trans_eq
        (dyadic_activeCell_right j)
    have hd : dist x y ≤ (dyadicMesh T m : ℝ) := by
      rw [NNReal.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hyx))]
      exact sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (add_comm y (dyadicMesh T m) ▸ hxy))
    exact (Real.dist_eq .. ▸
      hwmod x ⟨bot_le, ht _ _⟩ y ⟨bot_le, ht _ _⟩ (hd.trans_lt hmMesh)).le
  have hApprox : dist (S n) (V m n) ≤ ε / 3 := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hBlock]
    dsimp only [S]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), |w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) * z (σ n) i -
          w (t m (coarseCell hn i).castSucc) * z (σ n) i| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), δ * |z (σ n) i| := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [← sub_mul, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hOsc i) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ δ * C := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hM n).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hδ.le
      _ = ε / 3 := by
        dsimp only [δ]
        rw [← div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hC.ne']
  have hTriangle := (dist_triangle (S n) (V m n) I).trans
    (add_le_add (le_refl _) (dist_triangle (V m n) (L m) I))
  linarith

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.DyadicWeightedLimits

steps.title: Freeze the weights on a coarse grid
steps.text: Hold the coarse level m fixed. Once the fine level σ(n) is at least m, use the coarse left-endpoint weight for every fine cell it contains. The block identity and the prefix hypotheses give the limit as a finite sum of weighted primitive differences.
steps.lean:
intro t hPrefix
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hVar
  let C := max M 1
  have hC : 0 < C := zero_lt_one.trans_le (le_max_right _ _)
  let P (m : ℕ) (k : Fin (2 ^ m + 1)) (n : ℕ) :=
    ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), if t (σ n) i.succ ≤ t m k then z (σ n) i else 0
  let L (m : ℕ) := ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m), w (t m j.castSucc) *
    (prefixIntegral b T (t m j.succ) - prefixIntegral b T (t m j.castSucc))
  let V (m n : ℕ) := ∑ j : Fin (2 ^ m), w (t m j.castSucc) *
    (P m j.succ n - P m j.castSucc n)
  let S (n : ℕ) := ∑ i : Fin (2 ^ σ n), w (t (σ n) i.castSucc) * z (σ n) i
  let I := ∫ s, w s * b s ∂(TimeMeasure.upTo T)
  have hV (m : ℕ) : Tendsto (V m) atTop (𝓝 (L m)) := by
    refine tendsto_finsetSum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact ((hPrefix m j.succ).sub (hPrefix m j.castSucc)).const_mul _

steps.text: For these refining fine levels, each fine left endpoint and its coarse left endpoint are in the same coarse cell. Uniform continuity on [0,T] bounds the difference of the two weights. Multiply that bound by the uniform bound on total absolute mass.

    have hxy : x ≤ y + dyadicMesh T m := by
      exact (hfine.trans (fine_right_endpoint_le_coarse_right (T := T) hn i)).trans_eq
        (dyadic_activeCell_right j)
    have hd : dist x y ≤ (dyadicMesh T m : ℝ) := by

steps.title: Pass to the weighted integral
steps.text: The existing deterministic weighted time-sum theorem gives the limit of Lₘ. Choose m so both the freezing error and the error in Lₘ are small, then take the fine level sufficiently large.
steps.lean:
have hTriangle := (dist_triangle (S n) (V m n) I).trans
    (add_le_add (le_refl _) (dist_triangle (V m n) (L m) I))
  linarith

lesson.lean_statement: The fine levels are indexed by a map σ tending to infinity. The target prefix is the existing PrefixIntegral under TimeMeasure.upTo T.
lesson.lean_proof: Fix a coarse level chosen by uniform continuity and the existing time-sum limit. Then use eventual refinement and the finite combination of prefix limits.
